userSpecifiedSources:
Independent compilation of five U.S. government products:

- NOAA/NWS SPC tornado database: https://www.spc.noaa.gov/wcm/#data
- NOAA NCEI Storm Events: https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/stormevents/
- NOAA Event Footprint Catalog (derived from DAT and Storm Events): https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/products/event-footprint-catalog
- Census Population Estimates Program: https://www.census.gov/programs-surveys/popest.html
- Census 2020 Cartographic Boundary Files: https://www.census.gov/geographies/mapping-files/2020/geo/carto-boundary-file.html

v2 replaces the standalone DAT survey collection with annual footprint files. Footprints are damage regions, sometimes reconstructed or nested, not unique tornadoes or independent radar observations. Source URLs, retrieval times, generations, hashes, and original files are retained. Census estimates use vintage 2020 for 2010–2019 and vintage 2025 for 2020–2025 with a fixed 2020 map.

Fixed 2010–2025 study snapshot; no scheduled refresh. Code, limitations, and release receipts: https://github.com/jakeryderv/us-tornado-data-2010-2025

resources.description: Start here: scope, source counts, limitations, and loading examples. The analysis tables are directly downloadable; full original sources are inside release.zip.bin.
Platform-neutral dataset card covering scope, units of observation, fields, transformations, missingness, EF-rating limitations, and source attribution.
Original NOAA/NWS and Census source links, reuse notices, third-party exceptions, and citation guidance. Government records are distinct from MIT-licensed project code.
Detailed collection rules, directory layout, field interpretation, verification methods, and geographic/time-coverage limitations for the five-source collection.
Machine-readable citation metadata for the frozen release: title, author, version, release date, and code repository.
MIT license for project code and original documentation. This does not relicense government records; see DATA_SOURCES.md for source reuse terms.
Original CSV headers, EFC source field types, and complete consolidated table schemas. Field definitions and caveats are in ANALYSIS.md and NOAA source README.
Frozen v2.1.0 shared payload inventory: source snapshots, code revision, paths, byte sizes, and SHA-256. Use with SHA256SUMS to verify either host.
SHA-256 checksums for the shared payload and release_manifest.json. Use these after extraction; the outer transport archive hash is recorded separately in the GitHub release receipt.

Complete v2.1.0 dataset as a ZIP archive with an extra .bin suffix to retain original compressed files. Includes SPC/NCEI, annual NOAA footprints, Census, nine analysis tables, annual summary, and provenance. Extract with Python zipfile. Standalone DAT batches are absent.
Field dictionary for nine main tables plus annual summary; source IDs, types, geometry, timestamp conventions, placeholder widths, and EF/modeling limitations.

20,164 SPC tornadoes with all original fields and nullable EF labels, accepted-link counts, county population/housing summaries, and a suggested split group. Single starting table; linkage is automatic research evidence, not independently confirmed identity.

resources.description: All NCEI detail and footprint source records, with every candidate SPC link or a null-target unmatched row. Time/geometry evidence, acceptance decisions, ambiguity, source provenance, and confidence are retained.

columns.name: source_table
columns.description: Original analysis table: storm_events or tornado_footprints.

columns.name: source_id
columns.description: NCEI event_id or EFC footprint_id; interpret with source_table.

columns.name: source_group_id
columns.description: NCEI episode or EFC source/year-scoped family used for grouping; not necessarily a single tornado.

columns.name: source_origin
columns.description: NCEI, DAT, or SED origin of the linked source record.

columns.name: source_year
columns.description: Original source-file year; not necessarily the UTC calendar year.

columns.name: source_file
columns.description: Original source file path for tracing the record.

columns.name: source_row
columns.description: One-based record position in the source file.

columns.name: time_basis
columns.description: Fields used to interpret source event timestamps.

columns.name: input_issue
columns.description: Missing/invalid source time or geometry issue, or none.

columns.name: source_start_utc
columns.description: Selected source event start timestamp converted/interpreted in UTC.

columns.name: source_end_utc
columns.description: Selected source event end timestamp converted/interpreted in UTC.

columns.name: source_auto_eligible
columns.description: Whether source time/geometry are valid for automatic acceptance.

columns.name: tornado_id
columns.description: SPC tornado key; null only for a no-candidate source record.

columns.name: spc_start_utc
columns.description: SPC start converted using its fixed source time-zone code.

columns.name: spc_end_utc
columns.description: SPC end converted using its fixed source time-zone code.

columns.name: interval_gap_minutes
columns.description: Nonnegative separation between source and SPC time intervals, in minutes.

columns.name: interval_outside_minutes
columns.description: Maximum extension of source interval outside SPC interval, in minutes.

columns.name: start_delta_minutes
columns.description: Absolute source/SPC start-time difference in minutes; diagnostic only.

columns.name: geometry_gap_km
columns.description: Minimum source-geometry to SPC endpoint-track distance, kilometers.

columns.name: source_extent_distance_km
columns.description: Maximum source-vertex distance to the SPC endpoint track, kilometers.

columns.name: plausible
columns.description: Passes wider 10-minute and 5-km ambiguity guard.

columns.name: evidence_score
columns.description: Interval extension / 10 plus directed distance / 5. Lower is closer; not a probability.

columns.name: confidence
columns.description: High only for accepted rule-based links; none otherwise. Not measured precision.

columns.name: evidence_tier
columns.description: Strong, borderline, weak or none based on time/geometry evidence.

columns.name: candidate_rank
columns.description: One-based evidence-score order within source record; null with no candidates.

columns.name: candidate_count
columns.description: Number of broad-window SPC candidates for this source record.

columns.name: plausible_candidate_count
columns.description: Number passing the wider ambiguity guard; acceptance requires exactly one.

columns.name: accepted
columns.description: True only for unique, eligible, strict time/geometry links that pass family checks.

columns.name: match_status
columns.description: Accepted, ambiguous, review_required, outside_acceptance or unmatched.

columns.name: decision_reason
columns.description: Reason for acceptance or withheld acceptance.

resources.description: Accepted NCEI county/year records linked to SPC and left-joined to Census context. Repeated county segments stay visible; use unique county/year keys for sums.

columns.name: tornado_id
columns.description: SPC tornado key; null only for a no-candidate source record.

columns.name: ncei_event_id
columns.description: Accepted NCEI event identifier; multiple events may share a county/year.

columns.name: year
columns.description: NCEI event/source year used to join Census estimates.

columns.name: county_fips
columns.description: Five-character county FIPS string, preserving leading zeros.

columns.name: state_name
columns.description: Census state name; null when context is unavailable.

columns.name: county_name
columns.description: Census county or equivalent name; null when context is unavailable.

columns.name: population
columns.description: County population estimate, not tornado exposure.

columns.name: housing_units
columns.description: County housing unit estimate, not buildings struck.

columns.name: estimate_vintage
columns.description: Census source estimate vintage (2020 or 2025).

columns.name: map_2020_fips_present
columns.description: Whether county FIPS appears in the fixed 2020 map; not boundary stability.

columns.name: context_available
columns.description: True when the accepted NCEI county/year matched a Census row.

columns.name: link_basis
columns.description: accepted_ncei_county_code; county join derives from accepted source records, not polygon overlay.

resources.description: Crosswalk field definitions, conservative matching thresholds, uncertainty, county aggregation, and modeling/grouping limitations.
